title: Clarify Netflix section on homepage

requirements.text: Ensure the homepage includes a clearly identifiable Netflix section by rendering the existing `NetflixTop10` section in the main homepage flow (so users can easily find the Netflix-related content).

quotes: make it clear which is the netflix section

acceptanceCriteria: On the homepage, a Netflix-specific section is visible without requiring login.
The Netflix section is rendered using the existing `frontend/src/components/NetflixTop10.tsx` component and appears in the main `<main>` content flow (alongside Featured and Trending sections).
Clicking an item inside the Netflix section triggers the same trailer/open behavior as other media sections (i.e., uses the same `onMediaClick` handler wiring as other rows/grids).

requirements.text: Update the Netflix section’s header/labeling so it is unambiguous that the section is Netflix-related (e.g., the title text explicitly includes the word “Netflix”).

quotes: make it clear which is the netflix section

acceptanceCriteria: The Netflix section header includes clear English text that explicitly names Netflix (for example: “Netflix Top 10” or “Top 10 on Netflix”), not just “Top 10”.
The Netflix label is present in both loading and loaded states of the Netflix section.

The Netflix section remains visually distinct from other sections via its header block (e.g., Netflix logo + explicit Netflix text, consistent spacing), without reducing readability on dark/glass backgrounds.

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.

Frontend immutable paths must not be modified: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and anything under `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Keep changes scoped to clarifying which homepage section is the Netflix section; do not introduce new auth providers or external services.
nonGoals: Do not change TMDB fetching logic, ranking logic, or add new data sources for Netflix.
Do not redesign the entire homepage layout beyond what is necessary to make the Netflix section clearly identifiable.
